summary: Phase-2.2 additive features (Edit Suggested Needs + Scenario Compare) verified end-to-end on the live external URL. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase22.py (6 tests, all PASS in 1.85s): (1) PATCH /api/opportunities/opp-C with resources+resource_sources persists new values and returns USER_PROVIDED source labels; reverted to seeded (estimators=1, capital_cr=1.0). (2) PATCH on nonexistent opp -> 404. (3) POST /api/portfolio/scenarios (+1 specialist over baseline, objective=value) then POST /api/portfolio/scenarios/compare {baseline vs sid}: baseline.pursue = {opp-A, opp-C}; scenario.pursue includes opp-B (Chennai Elevated) and only_right contains opp-B. Both scenarios DELETE'd; scenarios list clean. (4) Compare with unknown right_id -> 404. (5) Baseline value optimize still yields {opp-A, opp-C}. (6) Opportunities list = 5. Full backend regression run sequentially (-n 0): 48/48 tests PASS in 234.84s (backend_test.py 36 + test_phase22.py 6 + test_phase2_followup.py 6). Frontend Playwright on live URL: (a) /analyses/demo-analysis-0001 Overview: edit-needs-btn -> edit-needs-form with needs-estimators/specialist_engineers/capital_cr/etc. Changed estimators 1->5, save-needs-btn -> success toast 'Resource needs updated', reopen shows 5, restored to 1. (b) /portfolio: set sim-specialist_engineers=2, scenario-name+save-scenario-btn -> scenario chip appears in saved-scenarios; scenario-compare panel becomes visible; cmp-left=Baseline, cmp-right=<scenario>, compare-scenarios-btn -> scenario-compare-result shows two columns: Baseline (Bengaluru+Hubballi) vs Scenario (Bengaluru+Chennai) plus 'Only in left: Hubballi', 'In both: Bengaluru', 'Only in right: Chennai'. Deleted scenario via del-scenario-{id} -> chip removed. Final workspace state verified via API: opp-C (estimators=1, capital_cr=1.0), opp-A (seeded values intact incl. equipment Launching Girder), 5 opps, 1 analysis, 0 scenarios. No regressions; demo workspace pristine.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio_routes.py PATCH /opportunities/{oid} uses body.model_dump() and filters keys != None, so intentional 'clear' via null is not supported. Consider model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so callers can explicitly null fields; minor.

AnalysisWorkspace saveNeeds always marks all resource keys USER_PROVIDED regardless of which fields were actually changed. This is fine functionally but slightly overreports provenance — could compare against original and only flip changed keys. Minor.
scenarios/compare has no size or dedup guard when left_id == right_id — returns identical left/right with empty diffs, which is harmless but could short-circuit or 400. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test scenarios created+deleted; opp-C and opp-A resources restored to seeded values. Final: 5 opps, 1 analysis, 0 scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-2.2 testids confirmed on live: edit-needs-btn, edit-needs-form, needs-{estimators|engineers|project_managers|specialist_engineers|capital_cr|bid_security_cr|bid_effort_days|value_cr}, save-needs-btn (AnalysisWorkspace Portfolio-impact panel — only rendered when the analysis is already linked to an opportunity, i.e. data.opp is present). Portfolio page: scenario-compare (panel — only visible when >=1 saved scenario exists), cmp-left, cmp-right (select with 'baseline' as first option), compare-scenarios-btn, scenario-compare-result. Backend endpoints: PATCH /api/opportunities/{oid} accepts {resources, resource_sources, value_cr, deadline, portfolio_override, portfolio_override_reason} — frontend is responsible for setting USER_PROVIDED source labels; server does NOT auto-mark. POST /api/portfolio/scenarios/compare {left_id, right_id, objective} — accepts 'baseline' as a sentinel id. Regression tip: keep using -n 0 (or --dist loadfile) — the pytest-xdist race on count-based tests reported in iteration_5 still exists when running -n 2 loadscope.
